question: What share of DAFpay gift volume in 2025-2026 bore the default 2.9% fee, a platform-negotiated fee, a donor-covered fee, Every.org's absorbed fee, or no fee under a Chariot subscription? Sources: Chariot investor/press disclosures, partner-platform annual reports (Give Lively, Givebutter), nonprofit audited statements or 990 Part IX 'fees for services' lines of large DAFpay recipients (e.g. Pan-Mass Challenge, >$5M via DAFpay in 2025)
conclusion_affected: Whether DAF payment layers extract rent from nonprofits; Q-B12 receipt-cost table
rationale: Every public price point found (11 partner platforms) is a list price; no source gives realised fee mix. Donor cover is allowed on 5 platforms and barred on 2, so who bears the fee varies by platform

question: When donors cover the DAFpay fee, the DAF grant is grossed up so charitable assets pay Chariot. How much DAF grant money went to DAFpay fees in 2025 (donor-covered plus nonprofit-paid), and do sponsors treat the covered fee as part of the charitable grant?
conclusion_affected: DAF payout quality; leakage from DAF grants to intermediaries
rationale: Give Lively, The Giving Block, Fundraise Up, Donorbox and BetterWorld let donors cover the fee ('donation will be increased by that amount'); no sponsor policy on covered fees was found

question: Do platform stacking fees make DAFpay more expensive than card for nonprofits on Bloomerang (4.85%), Donorbox (4.5%), Funraise and BetterWorld (3.9%), and is there evidence (forum posts, platform changelogs, Chariot 'Why did I receive an invoice' support volume) that nonprofits disable DAFpay after the 2026-10-14 terms?
conclusion_affected: Whether DAFpay is priced as data/conversion vs payment
rationale: Stacked DAFpay fees on four platforms exceed Stripe card pricing ($29.30 per $1,000). Chariot help states platforms 'activate DAFpay automatically for eligible nonprofits'; no removal data found

question: Commission or locate an independent outcome evaluation (randomised or matched comparison, third-party measured) of any live philanthropy agent: Blackbaud Development Agent, Benevity Match Assurance, Bonterra Que, Chariot gift coding or Circle Foundation intake agent. Re-scan quarterly for academic or auditor-verified results
conclusion_affected: AI value location; ai-use-case-inventory evidence classes
rationale: Of 21 agentic products classified, 0 have independent outcome evidence; 8 are deployed with vendor- or self-reported metrics only (e.g. Blackbaud 76x reply rate vs an unnamed benchmark; Benevity decline rate 30%->3%)

question: Track write-capable agent paths into DAF grant flows (Daffy MCP make_donation, TIFIN Louise, any Chariot DAFpay or Endaoment MCP tool, Fundraise Up Agentic Giving extended to DAF): which launch, with what usage, and does any sponsor record the agent as initiator? Re-check quarterly
conclusion_affected: Agentic control-gap matrix; 'agentic frontier is donor-side' finding
rationale: Only Daffy documents a write-capable agent tool that creates a DAF grant recommendation; Chariot's MCP is records-only and Fundraise Up's checkout has no DAF path. No usage figure exists for any of them
